page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; one marginal note at the right, beside the line "Respondet secundò Pearsonius usum". Running head at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: ceptâ primæ Cathedræ dignitate, cæteri omnes compresbyteri in functionibus Ecclesiasticis
esse quodammodo pares; sibi constitue-
re Episcopos idem est, nisi me fallit ani-
mus, quod eos sibi eligere & præficere.
Respondet secundò Pearsonius usum
hunc Alexandrinum qualis qualis sit non
esse disciplinæ Ignatianæ adeò contra-
rium, & ex diametro oppositum, ut inde
ignoratio Ignatij Epistolici colligi possit,
responsionis suæ hanc adfert rationem,
usum illum videlicet obtinuisse in vacati-
one sedis, & ad electionem aut prom-
otionem Episcopi tantùm spectare,
Ignatium verò de electione aut promotione
Episcopi nihil scripsisse. Sed hæc sec-
unda Viri docti solutio priore non est so-
[?]lidior: si enim Presbyteris Alexandrinis
licitum fuit sibi Episcopos constituere,
quidni etiam alias absque Episcopo functiones
obire? Et si quod est maximū jure
facere potuerunt, in minoribus functionibus
idem jus eis competivisse par est cre-
dere, ideóque Holstenius ex Hieronymi
verbis ritè colligebat Presbyteros Episco-
pis exceptâ primæ Cathedræ dignitate,
in functionibus Ecclesiasticis esse quodam-
modo pares: pares autem esse non pote-
rant nisi illis aliquid facere sine Episcopo conce[illegible, ~3 letters]m fuisset, cùm Episcopo quædam

page.notes: The page number is printed as "121" with a worn final digit; read as 121. A blot covers the end of "concessum" on the last line. The word "solidior" is split at the line end as "so-" and "lidior"; the first part is read with doubt. The mark after "obire" is a printed or smudged character, read as "?". The gathering signature at the foot is read as "Q".
